channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Gold advances as US-Iran framework deal, weaker Dollar support rebound
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) trades around $4,340 at the time of writing on Monday, up 2.86% on the day and extending the rebound that began on Thursday from the $4,024 area.

item.title: AUD/USD Price Forecast: Holds near 0.7090 with bullish pressure mounting
item.description: The Australian Dollar (AUD) trims previous gains against the US Dollar (USD) on Monday, as markets ponder the peace agreement between the US and Iran, ahead of a central bank-busy week.

item.title: Brent: Lower prices with key supports – Societe Generale
item.description: Societe Generale’s Kenneth Broux and colleagues note Brent has dropped sharply after the US–Iran MoU and reopening prospects for the Strait of Hormuz, with prices down 35% from April peaks but still above pre-war levels.

item.title: The BoJ is about to hike: Why the Japanese Yen is still pinned near 160.00
item.description: The Japanese Yen (JPY) continues to trade firmly around the psychologically crucial 160.00 level against the US Dollar.

item.title: Euro: Gradual upside path outlined – Rabobank
item.description: Rabobank’s FX Strategy team at RaboResearch Global Economics & Markets discusses how the Dollar initially benefited from safe haven flows during the Iran war, but has since softened as a ceasefire memorandum eased market tensions and tempered Fed hike expectations.

item.title: Global Macro: Hawkish pivot shapes risk landscape – HSBC
item.description: HSBC Asset Management’s Investment Weekly highlights how higher Oil prices, China’s export surge and US AI investment are reshaping the global macro backdrop.

item.title: Euro holds gains as risk appetite offsets downbeat Eurozone data
item.description: The Euro (EUR) maintains its positive tone against the US Dollar (USD) on Monday, with the EUR/USD pair trading near 10-day highs above 1.1600.

item.title: USD/JPY Price Forecast: Yen underperforms amid BoJ rate outlook uncertainty
item.description: The Japanese Yen (JPY) trades lower against its major currency peers during the European trading session on Monday, while the USD/JPY pair is marginally lower at around 160.15 after recovering its early losses.

item.title: Australian Dollar advances as US-Iran framework boosts risk appetite ahead of RBA decision
item.description: AUD/USD trades around 0.7070 at the time of writing on Monday, up 0.35% on the day, benefiting from renewed risk appetite after the United States (US) and Iran announced a framework agreement aimed at ending their conflict.

item.title: Indian Rupee holds strength on US-Iran deal finalization
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) trades strongly against the US Dollar (USD) in India's afternoon trading hours on Monday. The USD/INR pair plunges to near 94.60 as oil prices have nosedived, following the announcement that the United States (US) and Iran have reached a permanent peace deal.

item.title: US Dollar: Weaker path after US-Iran deal – MUFG
item.description: MUFG’s Lee Hardman notes that the US Dollar has extended losses after the US and Iran reached an interim agreement to end conflict and reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Swedish Krona: Riksbank caution weighs on Krona – BBH
item.description: Brown Brothers Harriman (BBH) expects the Riksbank to keep its policy rate at 1.75% for a sixth consecutive meeting and to lean against market pricing for a 25 bps hike by year-end.

item.title: British Pound: BoE hikes and politics cap Pound – BBH
item.description: Brown Brothers Harriman expects the Bank of England to hold at 3.75% with a 7–2 vote and sees the first fully priced 25 bps hike in November.

item.title: Silver price today: Silver rises, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Silver prices (XAG/USD) rose on Monday, according to FXStreet data. Silver trades at $70.69 per troy ounce, up 3.91% from the $68.03 it cost on Friday.

item.title: WTI falls below $79.00 to three-month lows
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude falls around 5%, reaching a three-month low of $78.60 per barrel on Monday. Crude oil prices declined to three-month lows on easing supply concerns following reports that the United States (US) and Iran had reached a deal to end their conflict.

item.title: Japanese Yen: High stakes around BoJ and Fed – Societe Generale
item.description: Societe Generale highlights USD/JPY trading near 160, with dips bought despite lower Oil and expectations of a 25 bp BoJ hike.

item.title: Eurozone Industrial Production rises moderately by 0.1% in April, misses 0.3% estimates
item.description: The Eurozone industrial sector activity rises at a moderate pace of 0.1% in April, slower than 0.3% estimates, according to data published by Eurostat. March’s Industrial Production data was revised higher to 0.4% from 0.2%.

item.title: Euro: Bid tone with defined ranges – Societe Generale
item.description: Societe Generale reports EUR/USD trading between 1.1569 and 1.1622 overnight, with the Euro bid above the 1.16 handle on the US–Iran MoU and lower Oil prices.

item.title: USD/CHF Price Forecast: Slips below 0.7950, nine-day EMA
item.description: USD/CHF depreciates nearly 0.5%, trading around 0.7930 during the European hours on Monday. The technical analysis of the daily chart indicates the pair is remaining within the ascending channel pattern, signaling an ongoing bullish bias.

item.title: EUR/GBP Price Forecasts: Bulls push against 0.8644 highs amid higher risk appetite
item.description: The Euro (EUR) shows a positive stance against the British Pound (GBP) on Monday, with bulls pushing toward one-week highs in the 0.8645 area.

item.title: British Pound: Faces policy and political risks – ING
item.description: ING’s Chris Turner highlights several risks for the Pound this week, centred on the Bank of England meeting and a key Labour by-election.

item.title: Euro gains against Japanese Yen on US-Iran deal, eyes on BoJ policy
item.description: The Euro (EUR) outperforms its major currency peers during the European trading session on Monday, trading 0.26% higher to near 185.85 against the Japanese Yen (JPY).

item.title: Japanese Yen: BoJ hike offers limited Yen relief – BBH
item.description: Brown Brothers Harriman expects the Bank of Japan to resume tightening with a 25 bps hike to 1.00%, but sees limited scope for a sustained Japanese Yen rally.

item.title: Dow Jones futures rise on US-Iran peace deal
item.description: Dow Jones futures gain over 1%, trading near 51,750 during the European hours on Monday, ahead of the US regular opening. However, S&P 500 futures rise 1.24% to near 7,530, and Nasdaq 100 futures advance 1.97%, trading near 30,250 at the time of writing.

item.title: Qatar to hold separate meetings with US-Iran officials before deal signing – AFP
item.description: According to a diplomatic source who told AFP, Qatar will hold separate meetings with officials from both the United States (US) and Iran in Doha to resolve any critical differences between nations before the deal signing on Friday, The Economic Times (ET) reported.

item.title: United States Dollar: Dollar explores downside risks – ING
item.description: ING analysts Chris Turner, Frantisek Taborsky and Francesco Pesole note that confirmation of a US-Iran ceasefire and the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz have pressured the Dollar as energy prices fall and risk assets rally.

item.title: Forex Today: Risk flows command markets on US-Iran peace deal yet to be signed
item.description: Here is what you need to know on Monday, June 15:

item.title: British Pound picks up amid peace hopes with central banks coming into focus
item.description: The British Pound (GBP) has drawn support from the US Dollar’s (USD) weakness, amid a brighter market mood on Monday, to hit a fresh 10-day high at 1.3460. The pair, however, remains trapped within the trading range from the last four weeks, as investors' focus shifts to monetary policy.

item.title: ECB’s Nagel: It will take months for oil supply to return to normal
item.description: European Central Bank (ECB) Governing Council Member and President of the Deutsche Bundesbank, Joachim Nagel, said during the European trading session on Monday that there seems to be no relief from high inflation in the foreseeable future, despite the finalization of the United States (US)-Iran pea

item.title: ECB’s Kazaks: Warned that upside inflation risks remain intact
item.description: European Central Bank (ECB) Governing Council member Martins Kazaks said during the European trading session on Monday that the central bank would be ready to raise interest rates, while warning of upside inflation risks despite the finalization of a deal between the United States (US) and Iran.
